verdict.rationale: smolagents is a Python agent library. Automatic event-triggered rules are a fair question for an agent framework, but the evidence shows no rule engine or event-trigger capability. Step callbacks and final_answer_checks are in-run developer hooks a programmer could use to build such behavior, not user-definable rules that fire actions on external events, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
